item.title: Sanju Samson surpasses Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma to enter elite list after marvellous knock
item.description: Star India batter Sanju Samson performed exceptionally well against the West Indies in game 52 of the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026. Scoring 97* runs in the run chase, Samson surpassed the likes of Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli in an elite list.

item.title: F-15 fighter jet of US Air Force crashes in Kuwait as Iran claims strike: Video
item.description: A US Air Force F-15 Strike Eagle crashed in Kuwait, with the pilot safely ejecting before impact. Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the cause amid rising regional tensions.

item.title: MWC 2026: Honor Robot Phone with embodied AI and motorised flip camera unveiled
item.description: Honor has unveiled its Robot Phone ahead of MWC 2026 under its Alpha strategy. The device features embodied AI, a motorised rotating 200MP flip camera, a compact 4DoF gimbal module, and AI-powered tracking, with launch expected later this year.

item.title: Gold rises to Rs 1.67 lakh per 10 grams on MCX, silver too rallies amid tensions in Middle East
item.description: In the international market, the COMEX gold price was up by 2.22 per cent to approximately USD 5,364.6 per troy ounce. The spot gold price at 11:00 am was USD 5,353.48 per ounce, up by USD 75.38 or 1.43 per cent.

item.title: Video shows Iranian missile dodging interceptors as Israel-Iran conflict intensifies | VIDEO
item.description: The video was reportedly recorded from a terrace. However, the exact location and time of the footage have not yet been confirmed. Some social media users have claimed it was filmed in Jerusalem, but this has not been officially verified.

item.title: Iranian drones strike Abu Dhabi naval base hosting French forces
item.description: Two Iranian drones struck Al Salam Naval Base in Abu Dhabi, a facility that hosts French forces. France confirmed damage to a hangar but said the overall impact was limited. No injuries have been reported.

item.title: Sonal Chauhan shares update after being stranded in Dubai amid US-Iran tensions
item.description: Sonal Chauhan is currently stranded in Dubai. Flights to Dubai have been suspended due to the ongoing war between the US, Israel, and Iran, leaving her stranded. She shared a post sharing the situation in Dubai with her fans.

item.title: PM Modi and Canada counterpart Mark Carney discuss trade, energy and investment
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Canadian PM Mark Carney in New Delhi for delegation-level talks at Hyderabad House. The leaders discussed trade, energy, investment and strengthening the India-Canada strategic partnership.

item.title: Iran says it struck multiple US air bases, military sites in Gulf: Full list of locations targeted
item.description: Iran struck US military bases across six Middle Eastern countries after a US-Israel joint operation in Tehran, killing Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and inflicting widespread destruction.

item.title: BCCI announces schedule for upcoming Afghanistan tour of India, set to be played in June 2026
item.description: The Indian team is all set to take on Afghanistan across one Test and three ODI matches in June 2026. Ahead of the series, the BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India) took centre stage and announced the schedule for the series.
